ABOUT HUT 8

Imagine the ultimate destination for those who want to work at the cutting edge of technology, energy, and infrastructure. Hut 8 is on a mission to build and operate some of the world’s largest data centers for next-generation computing workloads, including AI, Colocation, Cloud, and Bitcoin Mining. We are proud to offer interesting and challenging opportunities for individuals who want to build teams, solve problems, and make an impact from day one. If you’re an ambitious individual looking for a career that is as rewarding as it is challenging, you’ve come to the right place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Principal, Technology provides day-to-day operating support to the technology leader and five functional domains: Software Engineering, Data Science, IT, Networking, and Cybersecurity.

This role turns organizational priorities into coordinated execution. The principal manages intake, triages requests, drives meeting sprints and progress tracking, supports governance and audit activities, improves operating processes, and gives leadership a clear view of outcomes, active work, near-term plans, and decisions needed.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced technology project or program professional who can move comfortably between operational detail and executive-level priorities. The successful candidate will help create one coordinated technology organization while preserving the accountability and expertise of each domain.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the day-to-day operational support to the technology leader, helping translate priorities and decisions into clear actions, owners, and follow-through.
  • Manage a single intake process across the technology organization, triaging requests, routing work to the appropriate domain lead, and escalating unclear or cross-functional items for review.
  • Prepare and coordinate leadership projects, agendas, decisions, action items, and follow-ups for due diligence and prioritization.
  • Maintain visibility into cross-functional initiatives, dependencies, risks, and blocked work, acting as a proactive escalation point when delivery begins to slip.
  • Coordinate a consistent weekly reporting cadence across the five domains, including outcomes achieved, active work, near-term plans, risks, and decisions needed.
  • Support quarterly roadmap and portfolio planning by organizing inputs, applying shared prioritization criteria, and preparing recommendations for leadership decisions.
  • Support technology governance, audit, compliance, and control activities by coordinating evidence, owners, deadlines, and executive responses.
  • Identify recurring friction in how work is requested, prioritized, planned, communicated, and delivered, then help implement practical process improvements.
  • Act as an on-demand proxy into a specific domain or issue when additional coordination, investigation, or follow-through is needed.
  • Partner with the team to improve shared templates, tools, operating rhythms, and management practices over time.
  • Help coordinate communications across the technology organization so teams understand priorities, decisions, changes, and expectations, as well as the wider organization.

ABOUT YOU

  • 5+ years of experience in technology project management, technical program management, business analysis, operations, or a similar role.

  • Demonstrated experience coordinating work across multiple teams, functions, or technical stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of project and portfolio management fundamentals, including scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and ownership.
  • Technical literacy sufficient to work conversationally with engineering, data, infrastructure, networking, and cybersecurity teams. The ability to understand concepts such as APIs, systems integrations, networks, cloud services, and security controls is required; deep hands-on engineering expertise is not.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate operational detail into concise executive-level updates.
  • Excellent organization, prioritization, scheduling, meeting facilitation, and follow-through skills.
  • Sound judgment and practical instincts around escalation, missed commitments, ambiguous ownership, and slipping work.
  • Comfort operating in an evolving organization where priorities, responsibilities, and processes are still being defined.
  • Experience supporting governance, audit, compliance, or other deadline-driven control activities is preferred.
  • Experience in a technology organization is preferred. Experience limited to a non-technical business function may require significant ramp-up.

Working Style

The right person is proactive, practical, and comfortable being the connective tissue across teams. They do not wait for perfect information or formal direction to identify a gap, clarify ownership, and move work forward. They can challenge constructively, communicate directly, protect priorities, and build trust with both technical specialists and business leaders.

This role is not intended to replace the functional leads or become a centralized project-management bench. Its purpose is to provide operating leverage to the technology leader, coordinate work that crosses domains, and help the organization develop stronger distributed ownership over time.

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is in office at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

WHAT MAKES HUT 8 A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

Hut 8 offers a benefits and wellness program that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as paid time off. We are proud to invest in building the best team in the industry. At all levels of the organization, we are driven by an entrepreneurial spirit, radical transparency, and relentless growth mentality.

At Hut 8, you will have the opportunity to:

▶ Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting

▶ Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government

▶ Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team

▶ Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

The Role

We are hiring a Product Marketing Lead to own product marketing for our Risk Applications and Enabling Services portfolio, the products our customers depend on for AML screening, transaction monitoring, payment screening, fraud detection, case management, and regulatory reporting. This is the largest and most active half of our product portfolio, with new products and features shipping continuously. You'll take ownership of each product wherever it is in its lifecycle.

You will report to the VP of Product Marketing and be one of two Product Marketing Leads building out a newly-forming function. This is a foundational hire, with real latitude to shape how product marketing operates at ComplyAdvantage. You will partner closely with the Product Director who owns this portfolio, translating a steady stream of product and feature launches into positioning, enablement and go-to-market execution that Sales and Customer Success actually use.

We run a structured, phased launch process that's still evolving and you'll help shape it as you go, deciding what's genuinely differentiated and worth a moment, and what ships quietly as a release note.

This role has no direct reports today. It is a hands-on, individual-contributor role for someone who wants to own outcomes end to end rather than manage other people's output; someone who can take ambiguous input from Product and Sales and turn it into sharp positioning and a launch that lands, without needing a team underneath them to get there.

What You Will Do

Own product marketing for Risk Applications & Enabling Services. You are responsible for positioning, messaging, launch execution and enablement for this portfolio, end to end, from early roadmap conversations through GA and beyond.

Take ownership of products at every stage. Some products in this portfolio are newly launched or launching soon; you'll pick up their ongoing positioning, enablement and buyer narrative rather than starting from a blank page, and build out what's missing.

Lead launches end to end. Decide what earns a flagship moment versus what ships quietly, and own the launch plan, messaging and positioning brief for the releases that matter most.

Build the enablement Sales actually uses. Sales decks, demos, battlecards and FAQs written from a real understanding of the buyer and competitive landscape, not templated from a brief.

Contribute to competitive intelligence and win-loss. This is shared across the Product Marketing team for now; you'll help build the muscle until we have dedicated coverage.

Represent UK/EMEA (and APAC in the interim) market context. You're the voice of our primary market in company positioning, even as we build out dedicated regional coverage over time.

Partner with Product without owning their roadmap. You influence priorities through evidence, buyer feedback, competitive dynamics, win-loss signal, not through authority. You operate as a peer to a Product Director, not a downstream recipient of their decisions.

Use AI in your own work. We expect Product Marketing to use AI-assisted workflows for research synthesis, competitive analysis, and first-draft positioning and content. This is how we work, not an aspiration.

What We Are Looking For

Essential:

  • 7-10 years of overall professional experience, including 3-5+ years in product marketing
  • Experience at a high-growth, multi-product technology company; you understand what it means to market a portfolio, not a single product, and to prioritize across competing launches
  • Demonstrated ability to own a launch end to end: positioning, sales enablement, messaging and go-to-market, without heavy oversight
  • Strong independence and autonomy: comfortable defining your own plan within a broader strategy rather than waiting for detailed direction
  • Proven ability to influence without authority: you can shape a Product Director's or sales leader's thinking through evidence and argument, not reporting lines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: able to translate complex, technical product capability into a sharp, buyer-relevant narrative
  • Comfort operating in a regulated, technical B2B environment, translating product and engineering input into content a commercial audience can act on
  • Demonstrable AI adoption in your own working practice; already using it to work differently, not just interested in it

Preferred:

  • Experience in fintech, security, or identity markets
  • Experience marketing AI or agentic tools, platforms, or features
  • Experience marketing to multiple distinct buyer personas within the same portfolio
  • Familiarity with win-loss and competitive intelligence practices
  • Experience partnering with Sales on enterprise or upmarket motions

What Success Looks Like

At 60 days: You understand the Risk Applications and Enabling Services portfolio end to end, including any products that have recently launched or are approaching launch, and where our competitive and buyer knowledge has gaps. You've built working relationships with the Product Director for this portfolio, Sales leadership and Customer Success, and can articulate what's differentiated in our portfolio and why it matters to a buyer.

At 4 months: You are running launches independently through the tiered model. Your highest-priority products have positioning and a sales narrative that Sales trusts and uses, and your enablement materials are the ones reps actually reach for. You've built a first cut of the win-loss picture for your portfolio and can speak to it with data, not anecdote.

At 8 months: Your portfolio's go-to-market motion is measurably working; Sales can point to deals your positioning and enablement helped win. You're a trusted, senior voice in cross-functional planning for this portfolio, and you're operating at a level that could reasonably take on more scope as the team grows.

What’s in it for you?

  • Equity participation in our innovative mission to combat financial crimeUnlimited Time Off Policy to promote work-life balance and well-being
  • We embrace a hybrid approach that requires employees to be in the office for two days a week. We strongly believe that this approach fosters collaboration and enables the building of meaningful relationships
  • Opportunities for collaboration and career development with smart, like-minded professionals
  • Annual learning budget to support professional growth
  • A home office budget to support working from home
  • Enhanced parental leave and childcare benefits
  • Life insurance and medical coverage through BUPA, including pre-existing conditions
  • Pension contribution through The People's Pension

About us

Our mission is to empower every business to eliminate financial crime. 

By harnessing AI, a unified platform, and an extensive partner ecosystem, we help customers turn compliance into a catalyst for growth, operational resilience, and enduring regulatory trust.

More than 3,000 enterprises across 75 countries rely on our end-to-end platform and the world’s most comprehensive financial crime risk intelligence. With full-stack agentic automation, we help organizations automate up to 95% of KYC, AML, and sanctions reviews, cut onboarding times by 50%, reduce false positives by 70%, and handle 7x more work with the same staff.

ComplyAdvantage is headquartered in London and has global hubs in New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and Cluj-Napoca. It is backed by Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan, Goldman Sachs, and Andreessen Horowitz. Learn more about compliance re-engineered for the age of AI at complyadvantage.com.

descriptions.job-1gqv9em:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Brand Studio sits at the center of everything Stripe shows the world — from visual identity and brand systems to campaigns, events, digital experiences, and global marketing. The studio functions as a creative multiplier: setting the standards, building the systems, and producing the work that helps Stripe show up with intention and quality across every touchpoint.

World-class creative output requires world-class operational infrastructure. Brand Operations is the function that makes Brand Studio's work possible at scale — not by managing the execution, but by architecting the conditions that enable it. That means shaping what enters the studio, ensuring clarity before a brief is written, and building the systems that allow creative directors and producers to focus on what they're here to do: create exceptional work.

What you’ll do

Most operations leaders are brought in to fix problems. We're looking for someone who prevents them — and designs the system in which prevention becomes the norm.

The Head of Brand Operations exists upstream from creative execution. This role's job is to ensure the work entering Brand Studio is strategically aligned, clarified, prioritized, resourced, and fully prepared for delivery before it ever reaches a creative director or producer. It also means ensuring the company understands how to work with Brand Studio — what it takes to be a ready partner, and where a given initiative stands on the roadmap. When that infrastructure is working, creative leaders spend their time and energy on the thing they're actually here to do.

This role lives at the altitude of setting the team up for success. That means the early-stage, ambiguous conversations where partners are still forming ideas — where the business need hasn't been articulated, where the biggest risks and opportunities haven't been named, and where a structural decision will compound over time. It means building and maintaining a roadmap the entire company can see and trust. And it means leading a team of producers who own their projects fully, with your role being the system that makes their ownership meaningful.

This role isn't about staying out of the details entirely — it's about not defaulting to them. You'll roll up your sleeves when the moment calls for it. But your primary value is in designing the ecosystem, not running the work. If you want to build the system in which great work consistently becomes possible — and watch it scale — this is a rare opportunity to do that.

Responsibilities

  •  Architect the Brand Studio ecosystem. Engage cross-functional partners — Marketing, Product, Comms, PMM — before briefs exist. Turn ambiguous asks into clear, sequenced workstreams so creative leaders inherit clarity, not chaos.
  • Build and maintain the Brand Studio roadmap. Sequence and prioritize work based on business importance, creative opportunity, and team capacity. Give leadership a forward-looking view of what's coming — and the tradeoffs involved.
  • Set the conditions for great work. By the time a project reaches a creative director or producer, the business need is defined, stakeholders are aligned, and the problem is framed. Creative leaders shape the work. You shape the environment that makes the work possible.
  • Own and evolve the operational infrastructure. Build the intake processes, alignment frameworks, and communication rhythms that help Brand Studio run at scale. Refine them as the team grows.
  • Make how Brand Studio works visible to the company. Partners should be able to find the roadmap, understand where their project stands, and know what it takes to show up ready. The process of working with Brand Studio shouldn't require a meeting to explain.
  • Run the business of Brand Studio. Own the budget, manage agency and external production partnerships from procurement through delivery standards, and partner with Finance on clear accounting structures. Give the team the resources and partnerships it needs to deliver.
  • Lead, develop, and set the cultural tone. Hire great people, build their judgment, and set clear ownership. Give direct feedback, delegate fully, and create the stability that lets people do their best work. You're a steward of how this team shows up — the norms, the standards, and what it means to operate at this level.
  • Stay attuned to what's forming. Brand-level initiatives take shape before briefs exist. Catch early signals across the company and help shape ambiguous ideas into clear outcomes before they reach the studio.
  • Represent Brand Studio at the leadership level. Keep senior leaders informed on priorities, direction, and impact. Make the case for what deserves investment, what should wait, and why.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 12+ years of experience in brand operations, creative operations, or creative program management. A track record of building operational systems at the function level, not just executing inside them.
  • 5+ years managing a team of producers, program managers, or operations professionals, with clear evidence of developing talent and building production capability.
  • Demonstrated experience engaging cross-functional partners before briefs are written — shaping workstreams, clarifying business needs, and setting creative teams up to succeed.
  • Experience building and owning an annual creative roadmap for a team or function, including prioritization frameworks, capacity planning, and tradeoff communication with senior leadership.
  • A track record of building operational infrastructure — intake processes, prioritization systems, partner communication frameworks — that scaled and outlasted your direct involvement.
  • Experience managing significant budgets, including developing transparent accounting structures in partnership with Finance.
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with the ability to align competing priorities and influence without authority across a large, cross-functional organization.
  • People management instincts that build team judgment rather than dependency — genuine delegation, direct feedback, and a consistent bias toward developing others over personal execution.
  • Experience incorporating AI into team workflows and driving measurable adoption across a creative or operations team.

Preferred qualifications

  •  Experience inside a world-class in-house creative studio or brand team, with deep familiarity with the full creative production lifecycle — from strategy and concept through final delivery.
  • A track record of building or rebuilding a brand operations function from scratch within a company or team at scale.
  • Experience managing global creative agency and external production partnerships end to end — from procurement and onboarding through creative direction and delivery standards.
  • Deep understanding of how brand, marketing, and product teams operate at a technology company, with the instincts to bridge creative ambition and business priorities.
  • Experience building operational transparency systems — roadmaps, dashboards, or partner-facing communication frameworks — that gave an entire organization real-time visibility into a creative team's capacity and priorities.
  • Experience building creative process standards, playbooks, or partnership guidelines that became lasting institutional infrastructure.

Risk Parameter Design & Iteration
  • Develop maximum leverage, position limit strategies per instrument, dynamically adjusted based on market depth
  • Design ADL (Auto-Deleveraging) trigger mechanisms and ranking rules, optimizing user experience and risk isolation effectiveness
Risk Monitoring & Alerts
  • Design insurance fund utilization rules and replenishment mechanisms
  • Develop circuit breaker contingency plans and emergency response procedures for extreme market events (flash crashes, liquidity crises)
  • Monitor abnormal Mark Price deviations from spot index to prevent unreasonable liquidations
Cross-Department Collaboration
  • Collaborate with product teams to define risk control admission criteria for new derivative listings (token liquidity, market cap, volatility thresholds)
  • Participate in Market Surveillance to investigate suspected manipulation of liquidations, wash trading, pump-and-dump, and other market violations
──────

Qualifications

Required
  • Bachelor's degree or above in Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or related fields
  • 3+ years of derivatives-related experience, including traditional finance (futures/options market making, risk management) or crypto exchange risk management
  • Deep understanding of perpetual contract mechanics (funding rate, Mark Price, liquidation logic) and differences from traditional futures
  • Proficient in Python, capable of independently conducting data analysis, parameter backtesting, and model validation
  • Solid foundation in probability theory and statistics, understanding of VaR, Expected Shortfall, and other risk measurement methodologies
Preferred
  • Familiarity with options pricing theory, with experience in volatility smile/surface modeling
  • Proficiency in SQL / Spark, able to independently query on-chain or exchange internal data

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.

descriptions.job-11hz4bi:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Commercial Legal team is at the forefront of Kraken’s global business operations, serving as strategic legal partners across all departments. This lean and dynamic group is responsible for managing a wide range of commercial contracts and supporting the company in its partnerships, procurement, licensing, and vendor relationships. The team plays a key role in enabling Kraken’s rapid innovation and expansion while protecting the business from legal and regulatory risks.

As Assistant General Counsel – Commercial (Partnerships), you will report directly to the Head of Commercial Legal. You will be responsible for leading Kraken’s product partnership commercial legal efforts, working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Finance, Engineering, and Regulatory teams to craft and launch novel and strategically significant products and partnerships at the most innovative financial exchange in the world.

 

The opportunity

  • Serve as the lead commercial counsel for cutting edge, high visibility product partnerships, driving legal strategy and execution for complex and first-of-their-kind commercial arrangements that support Kraken’s most innovative product initiatives.

  • Act as a strategic partner to the Product, Sales, Engineering, Finance, and Regulatory teams, helping design go-to-market structures and partnership models that are legally sound and support rapid innovation.

  • Advise leadership and stakeholders on a wide range of commercial legal matters and negotiations, including technology agreements, strategic partnerships, and terms of service.

  • Oversee the development and continuous improvement of legal templates, playbooks, AI processes, and risk management frameworks that support scalable and efficient commercial operations.

  • Collaborate closely with Compliance, Tax, and Regulatory teams to assess legal risk and implement practical, forward-thinking solutions that unlock business opportunities.

  • Support contract lifecycle management and help drive legal process automation and tooling improvements across the function.

  • Assist with M&A efforts as needed, including contract diligence and integration.

  • Additional responsibilities and special projects as assigned by the Head of Commercial Legal.

 

What you bring

  • J.D. or equivalent legal degree and active license to practice law in at least one jurisdiction.

  • 8+ years of commercial legal experience, ideally a mix of top-tier law firm and in-house experience.

  • Proven track record leading complex, high-stakes commercial transactions in a global environment, particularly those involving technology, SaaS, or strategic partnerships.

  • Deep understanding of product development and go-to-market strategies from a legal perspective.

  • Excellent contract drafting, negotiation, and analytical skills.

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, including mentoring and managing high-performing teams.

  • Ability to operate independently and decisively in a fast-paced, remote-first, innovation-driven environment.

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience in fintech, crypto, or other highly regulated sectors.

  • Familiarity with vendor onboarding, procurement processes, and compliance frameworks.

  • Background working closely with product and engineering teams to develop and launch consumer-facing and enterprise products.

  • Experience implementing or managing contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools.

  • Passion for crypto, Web3, and emerging technologies.

 
 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

At Shakepay, we’re on a mission to usher in the bitcoin golden age. We’re reimagining financial services to give every Canadian their fair shake.

Our culture is built around doing work that matters, winning as a team, and celebrating success. If you're the kind of person who values growth, shipping fast, and sharing your ideas openly with a group of like-minded people, come and build with us!

About Shakepay

Since 2015, we've been on a mission to help Canadians build long-term wealth through bitcoin. Over the past few years, we've expanded beyond buying and selling bitcoin to offer a growing suite of everyday financial products - including the Shakepay Card, direct deposit, bill payments and Interac e-Transfer - making it easier to earn, save and use bitcoin every day. Today, more than 1.5 million Canadians use Shakepay to grow their bitcoin savings and take control of their financial future as we continue to push the boundaries of what modern financial services can look like.

We’re regulated as an investment dealer across all Canadian provinces and territories, and backed by renowned venture capitalists with a funding of $44M. We have a passionate, loyal, and growing community, and we’re looking for people who want to help us build something truly special.

About the Platform Team

The Platform team empowers other engineering teams at Shakepay by providing the tools, infrastructure, and best practices they need to be autonomous, productive, and reliable. As the Platform Engineering Manager, you’ll ensure we balance fast delivery with operational excellence.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead and grow a team of platform engineers with a focus on Infrastructure, SRE and DevOps .

This role is responsible for people leadership, technical direction, and delivery across platform initiatives that impact every engineering team at Shakepay. You’ll partner closely with Engineers, Engineering leaders, Security, and Compliance, and lead by example, staying hands-on where it matters to shape technical decisions, support delivery, and ensure our platform evolves in step with both developer and business needs. You’ll also play a key role in developing an agentic layer of the platform, building intelligent tooling and agentic workflows that automate repetitive work, assist engineers in complex tasks, and enable teams across the company to interact with systems and data in new ways

You don’t need to be the deepest expert in every area, but you must be technically strong enough to set direction, challenge assumptions, and make tradeoffs across DevEx, infrastructure, and reliability.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of platform engineers across Infrastructure, DevOps and Developer Experience.
  • Set technical direction for platform architecture and ensure roadmap execution
  • Balance short-term delivery with long-term investments in tooling, infrastructure, and reliability
  • Oversee cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and operational tooling in a regulated environment
  • Design and build AI-powered internal tools and agentic workflows that automate tasks and augment engineering productivity
  • Improve developer productivity by reducing friction in onboarding, CI/CD, and local-to-prod workflows
  • Ensure systems are secure, scalable, observable, and resilient as Shakepay grows
  • Own incident management practices, postmortems, and sustainability of the on-call rotation
  • Collaborate closely with product engineering, security, and compliance stakeholders
  • Advocate for platform work by tying technical initiatives to business and customer impact

Who We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, DevOps or SRE roles
  • 3+ years managing and growing high-performing teams
  • Familiarity with technologies like Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, ArgoCD, Datadog, PostgreSQL, CI/CD tooling, and GitOps
  • Experience operating production systems and supporting on-call rotations
  • Ability to set technical direction across both developer experience and infrastructure
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a focus on business impact
  • Comfort using AI tools in your day-to-day workflow to accelerate development, debugging, and learning

Bonus points

  • Experience in fintech or other regulated environments
  • Prior experience as a Staff or Senior Engineer before moving into management
  • Interest in Bitcoin and excitement to learn more

Why join us?

  • Help shape the future of money: Be part of a team that's revolutionizing financial services in Canada, one sat at a time.
  • Impact millions: As cryptocurrency continues to gain traction, our potential for growth is massive. You can help us bring Shakepay and Bitcoin to all Canadians.
  • Grow your career: We’re growing, and so can you! We have programs in place to encourage continuous learning, growth, and development.
  • Ideas, not titles: We want the best ideas to make their way through, no matter where they come from.

Perks and benefits

  • 🤖 Generous AI token budget (currently unlimited)
  • 🤝 Stock options as part of their total compensation
  • 🦷 Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget to take care of your mental health
  • 🌎 Remote-friendly: Work from anywhere in Canada, with optional access to our office spaces in Montreal and Toronto.
  • 🆙 A $2,000 annual budget for courses, certifications, and training to support your career growth.
  • 🌴  20 days of vacation per year. And if you use all your vacation, we give you a $1,000 bonus.
  • 🐣 Parental leave top up to 100% of your salary for 18 weeks.
  • 🙌 Quarterly team-specific or company-wide offsite to connect with each other

The base salary range for this position is $230,000 - 280,000 CAD. Base pay may vary based on factors such as years of experience, skills and qualifications. Additionally, employees are eligible for equity,  pay increases based on performance, benefits including health and dental care, and paid time off.

We understand that potential can be just as valuable as experience. If you're eager to learn, grow, and contribute to the mission but worry that you may not have the “right” experience, we still want you to apply. We encourage applications from everyone, regardless of background and life experience. We’re firm believers that a little bit of slope makes up for a lot of y-intercept.

Fluency in English is required due to the percentage of English-speaking customers and the nature of our platform, which is available to all Canadians.

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support certain parts of our hiring process. This can include tools that assist with scheduling, application review, candidate communications, and generating interview notes, guides, or summaries so our team can stay focused on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.

descriptions.job-173izxa:
What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

As a Recruiter at Kalshi, you'll own full-cycle recruiting across the entire company - from engineering and product to compliance, operations, and go-to-market. You'll partner directly with hiring managers and leadership to define what great looks like for a role, go find it, and close it. There's almost no red tape here: no drawn-out approval chains, no bureaucracy standing between you and a great candidate. It’s the right role for you if you’re incredibly self-directed, you move fast, take ownership over your pipelines, and can attract → close the best talent in the world.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for a mix of technical and non-technical roles, from intake through offer and close

  • Partner directly with hiring managers and leadership to build role scorecards, sharpen hiring criteria, and design efficient interview processes

  • Proactively source and engage passive candidates across channels, building strong outbound pipelines rather than waiting on inbound

  • Manage a high-volume, fast-moving pipeline while maintaining a high bar and a great candidate experience

  • Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers on market data, leveling, and competitive offers

  • Represent Kalshi's mission and culture compellingly to candidates at every stage

 

What You Bring

  • 6+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally spanning both technical and non-technical hiring

  • Proven ability to build strong outbound pipelines and close passive candidates, not just manage inbound flow

  • Comfort operating across very different hiring profiles - from engineers to operators to compliance and gtm hires - without losing quality or speed

  • Strong judgment and the ability to move fast and make decisions autonomously in a low-process environment

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, especially with senior hiring managers

  • Genuine excitement about working somewhere fast-moving with minimal bureaucracy and high ownership

  • Bachelor's degree preferred, not required

 

NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure

Salary Range: $175,000 - $250,000 annually plus equity and benefits. This range reflects current market data for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title; if your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out - we're always happy to discuss.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.
descriptions.job-0bwbrxa:
About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who We Are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure. 

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About The Role

Riot Platforms is looking for a Systems Engineer, IAM to own our Microsoft Entra and identity environment and engineer how we run it. This is a role for someone equally comfortable administering identity and access today and automating it as code tomorrow – managing Entra ID, conditional access, endpoints, and Microsoft 365, while applying infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and modern DevOps practices in equal measure.

This position sits at the center of our shift from traditional system administration to a DevOps operating model. You’ll keep our identity, device, and Microsoft 365 environment secure and reliable, and progressively replace manual processes with automation, version-controlled configuration, and repeatable pipelines. You’ll work closely with software engineering, IT, and cyber security, and provide visibility across our Data Center, Bitcoin Mining, and Manufacturing operations.

This position will be based in our Austin or Castle Rock office.

What You'll Do

  • Administer Microsoft Entra ID – Manage users, groups, roles, application registrations, and enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC) across the organization.
  • Manage access and privileged identity – Build and maintain conditional access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), MFA, and just-in-time access workflows (including StrongDM) to enforce least privilege.
  • Operate hybrid identity – Maintain on-premises Active Directory, Entra Connect synchronization, and hybrid identity across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Manage endpoints with Intune and Jamf – Configure device management, compliance, and endpoint security policies through Microsoft Intune and Jamf.
  • Administer Microsoft 365 – Manage Exchange Online, licensing, and broader Microsoft 365 services to keep collaboration secure and reliable.
  • Automate configuration as code – Define and manage identity and infrastructure configuration using tools such as Terraform, AWS CDK, and SaltStack to make environments repeatable and auditable.
  • Build CI/CD and automation pipelines – Replace manual administrative tasks with version-controlled automation and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions).
  • Script and build tooling – Develop automation in PowerShell, Python, or C# to streamline provisioning, reporting, and routine operations.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging – Stand up observability and audit logging across identity, endpoints, and infrastructure using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana and native cloud tooling.
  • Advance the DevOps operating model – Help mature standards, documentation, and engineering practices as the team moves from manual administration toward a DevOps operating model.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field – equivalent experience considered.
  • 4+ years of experience in systems engineering, system administration, or identity and access administration.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID and/or Active Directory required.
  • Microsoft or cloud certification preferred.

Nice to Have

  • Preferred - Relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g., SC-300 Identity and Access Administrator, AZ-104, or equivalent)
  • Preferred - Experience automating Entra and Microsoft 365 administration with Microsoft Graph (PowerShell SDK or API)
  • Demonstrated experience supporting SOC compliance programs, including control implementation, audit preparation, risk management, documentation governance, and coordination with internal and external auditors.
  • Experience supporting a transition from manual system administration to a DevOps / infrastructure-as-code model
  • Experience with cryptocurrency, blockchain, or high-performance computing environments
  • Experience in manufacturing, construction, energy, mining, data center, or other capital-intensive industries
  • Exposure to AWS or other multi-cloud environments

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: $115,000 - $135,000 (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant
  • 401(k) plan with company matching
  • Great medical, vision, and dental plans to choose from
  • Long-term and short-term disability
  • Additional benefit options (Employee Assistance Program, Pet Insurance, and more)
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Generous PTO and Paid Holidays
  • A fun company culture with tremendous growth opportunities

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Platform

Our Platform organization’s purpose is to enable Gemini to scale effectively and empower our engineering teams to focus on building innovative financial products and experiences for individuals around the world. Platform focuses on building a scalable and secure foundations platform, enabling Engineering to develop, deploy, validate, and operate services in production; improve resiliency; increase organizational efficiency by reducing operational toil; and improve system efficiency through architectural evolution.

The Platform team builds products for engineers. We work directly with product, data, security, and infrastructure teams to understand their needs, establish safe and opinionated defaults, and provide paved paths that make the reliable choice the easy choice. We treat internal platforms as production software with users, service-level objectives, roadmaps, documentation, and feedback loops, not as collections of configuration.

The Role: Senior Platform Engineer

You will design, build, and operate the software and infrastructure that form Gemini’s internal engineering platform. This is a software engineering role grounded in deep production and infrastructure experience. You will build self-service systems, developer tools, and automation that improve the way teams create, deploy, scale, observe, and operate services.

You will partner with engineering teams to turn broad operational needs into reliable platform products. You will make infrastructure programmable, secure, observable, and resilient; use SLOs and error budgets to guide tradeoffs; and continuously replace manual operational work with well-designed software. The role spans software, systems, and infrastructure engineering, with an emphasis on durable abstractions and measurable improvements to developer velocity and production reliability.

The role spans cloud platforms, networking, compute, storage, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, and the systems required to run highly available services in production.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain platform services, APIs, CLIs, controllers, and automation in languages such as Go, Python, or similar; own them through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation.
  • Build self-service capabilities that let engineers provision environments, deploy services, manage infrastructure, and respond to operational conditions safely without relying on manual platform intervention.
  • Create and evolve paved paths for service development and delivery, including templates, libraries, deployment workflows, policy-as-code, and reusable platform primitives.
  • Design and improve the cloud, compute, storage, identity, and infrastructure primitives used by engineering teams.
  • Design and operate core network infrastructure — VPCs, Cloud Routing, and security controls across public clouds and regions. 
  • Operate and improve the compute, container, networking, and cloud foundations that support critical services and emerging workloads, including distributed and AI-enabled systems where appropriate.
  • Improve the systems and workflows used to provision infrastructure, connect services, deliver changes, and recover from failures across environments.
  • Define and use service-level indicators, SLOs, error budgets, and production-readiness standards to make reliability and launch decisions explicit and measurable.
  • Improve observability, alerting, capacity planning, performance, and failure handling; design systems that degrade gracefully, roll out progressively, and recover automatically where safe.
  • Participate in an appropriately staffed on-call rotation, lead incident response when needed, and turn incidents and recurring operational work into permanent improvements through blameless postmortems and follow-through.
  • Reduce toil deliberately. Measure repetitive operational work, automate or eliminate it, and keep the team focused primarily on engineering work that improves reliability, scale, security, cost, or developer experience.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams on architecture, productionization, and technical design; provide guidance without becoming a ticket-based operations layer.
  • Establish technical direction through design documents, prototypes, testing, metrics, and iterative delivery. Make pragmatic tradeoffs while preserving clear interfaces and room for future evolution.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering, infrastructure engineering, SRE, or an equivalent combination of experience, including meaningful ownership of production systems.
  • Strong software engineering ability in at least one language such as Go, Python, Java, Rust, or similar, with experience building maintainable services, automation, CLIs, APIs, or developer tools - not only scripts or one-off configuration.
  • Demonstrated experience operating infrastructure and distributed systems in production, including diagnosing failures, managing capacity, improving performance, and designing for high availability and recovery.
  • Experience designing, operating, or improving production systems across cloud infrastructure, networking, compute, storage, deployment platforms, or related infrastructure domains.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure and infrastructure as code, such as Terraform or an equivalent system.
  • Experience with containers and orchestration, such as Kubernetes, EKS, GKE, Docker, or Nomad, including workload deployment, networking, security, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Experience owning and managing cloud network security controls, including network firewalls, DNS filtering, and network segmentation.
  • Experience designing or improving CI/CD and automated software delivery systems, including testing, deployment, progressive rollout, rollback, and change validation.
  • Practical experience with observability: metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards, and production health models. Familiarity with OpenTelemetry or comparable tooling is valuable.
  • Working knowledge of SLOs, error budgets, incident response, blameless postmortems, and techniques for reducing operational toil.
  • Experience with high-availability architectures, capacity planning, failure recovery, and the operational tradeoffs required to run critical systems at scale.
  • Experience building secure-by-default systems and collaborating with security teams on identity, access control, secrets, supply-chain security, and policy enforcement.
  • Experience working with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet is useful, but configuration management alone is not sufficient for this role.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and domains quickly, including the infrastructure and reliability characteristics of data-intensive, event-driven, or AI/ML workloads.
  • Strong technical communication and leadership skills; able to explain tradeoffs, influence across teams, mentor others, and turn ambiguous problems into shipped systems.
It Pays to Work Here
 
The compensation & benefits package for this role includes:
  • Competitive starting pay
  • A discretionary annual bonus
  • Long-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant
  • Comprehensive health plans
  • 401K with company matching
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible time off

Salary Range: The base salary range for this role is between $140,000 - $200,000 in the State of New York. This range is not inclusive of our discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

In the United States, we offer a hybrid work approach at our hub offices, balancing the benefits of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Expectations may vary by location and role, so candidates are encouraged to connect with their recruiter to learn more about the specific policy for the role. Employees who do not live near one of our hubs are part of our remote workforce. All employees, however, are required to onboard in-person at one of our office locations.

At Gemini, we strive to build diverse teams that reflect the people we want to empower through our products, and we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Equal Opportunity is the Law, and Gemini is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. If you have a specific need that requires accommodation, please let a member of the People Team know.

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
 

  • About the Role

     
    We are looking for a senior leader to head our newly formed Trading Risk team. This is a critical leadership role created as part of a strategic reorganization to consolidate all business-risk-related functions across our trading verticals into a single, dedicated team. The Head of Trading Risk will own end-to-end business risk operations and logic design across multiple product lines, reporting directly to senior leadership.
     
    Key Responsibilities
     
    Team Leadership & Strategy
     
    • Lead and grow the Trading Risk team, setting the strategic vision for business risk management across the organization
    • Build a high-performing, risk-focused culture with strong accountability and ownership
    • Define team OKRs, establish performance standards, and drive continuous improvement
    • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to embed risk thinking into product development
     
    Risk Coverage — Multi-Product Line Oversight
     
    • Own business risk operations and logic design across:
    • Spot Trading — market risk, counterparty exposure, and trading anomaly detection
    • Derivatives (Futures, Options, CFD, Perps) — margin risk, liquidation logic, settlement risk, and position limits
    • Loan / Earn — collateral risk, interest rate risk, and protocol-level exposure management
    • Design and maintain risk control frameworks, alert systems, and escalation protocols for each product line
    • Conduct ongoing risk assessments for new product launches and feature changes
    • Provide risk-related logic design recommendations and improvement proposals for all business units
     
    Operational Risk Management
     
    • Oversee real-time risk monitoring systems and ensure timely incident response
    • Define and enforce risk parameters (position limits, margin requirements, circuit breakers, etc.)
    • Lead post-mortem analysis on risk incidents and drive systematic remediation
    • Work with the Engineering/Tech team to ensure risk control systems are robust, scalable, and properly maintained
     
    Requirements
     
    Must-Have
     
    • 8+ years of experience in risk management within financial services, fintech, or crypto/digital assets
    • 3+ years in a leadership role managing risk teams (team size 5+)
    • Deep understanding of derivatives risk (futures, options, perpetual swaps, CFDs) — including margin models, liquidation engines, and settlement processes
    • Experience with multi-product risk management covering at least 3 of: spot, derivatives, lending, earn/yield products
    • Strong quantitative background — ability to design and validate risk models, parameters, and control logic
    • Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex risk concepts for product and business stakeholders
    • Proven ability to build and scale risk teams from the ground up or through significant transformation
    • AI-first mindset — actively leverages AI/ML tools and techniques to enhance risk detection, automate workflows, and improve decision-making efficiency
    • Programming proficiency in Python and/or C++ — able to build risk models, prototype monitoring tools, and work directly with quantitative codebases
    • Fluent in English; proficiency in Mandarin Chinese is strongly preferred
     
    Nice-to-Have
     
    • Experience in crypto/digital asset exchanges or high-frequency/algorithmic trading environments
    • Background in TradFi risk management (banks, prop trading, hedge funds) transitioning to crypto
    • Familiarity with market surveillance tools and techniques
    • Experience with risk-related system architecture and working closely with engineering teams
    • Advanced degree (MSc/PhD) in quantitative finance, financial engineering, mathematics, or related field
     
    What We Offer
     
    • Direct leadership of a strategically important, newly formed team with executive visibility
    • Opportunity to define risk frameworks from the ground up across an expanding product ecosystem
    • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
    • Fast-paced environment with real impact on business decisions

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

descriptions.job-1vd6w9q:
ABOUT SPHERE

Every breakthrough in trade infrastructure has followed the same pattern: reduce a transaction cost, expand the market. Containerization for goods. SWIFT for money. Stripe for payments. Compliance is one of the last and largest — and the hardest, because trade rules aren't data to be looked up. They're a complex adaptive system with 190+ sovereign jurisdictions, in different languages, changing constantly, reacting to each other.

Sphere built the system that solves it. Our AI (TRAM) ingests global trade law, interprets it, resolves conflicts across jurisdictions, and produces compliance determinations more reliable than human experts. We handle the entire lifecycle — calculation, registration, filing, remittance — at millisecond latency with zero downtime.

  • Backed by a16z and YC. $21M Series A, 30%+ month-over-month growth, customers include ElevenLabs, Replit, Deel, Runway, and Lovable.

  • Small team, global surface area. Everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. San Francisco, in office.

  • The problem keeps compounding. Expanding into input tax, withholding, e-invoicing, tariffs — each multiplies the complexity. Tens of millions of transactions today, billions ahead.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Tax Operations Specialist to partner with our Customer Success team and help customers successfully navigate complex tax compliance requirements using our platform.

In this role, you'll serve as a tax subject matter expert and trusted partner to customers, helping them understand tax requirements, troubleshoot compliance workflows, and optimize their use of our technology. You'll work closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Tax teams to translate customer needs into actionable insights and scalable solutions.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong tax knowledge with excellent communication skills and enjoys solving customer problems through a mix of technical understanding, operational expertise, and collaboration.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Within days:

  • Develop a deep understanding of our tax platform, customer workflows, and product capabilities.

  • Build relationships with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Tax teams.

  • Learn our customers' tax compliance needs, common challenges, and implementation workflows.

  • Become a trusted internal resource for tax-related customer questions and escalations.

  • Review existing customer processes and identifying opportunities to improve the customer experience.

Within months:

  • Partner with our Customer Success Lead to support customer implementations, onboarding, and ongoing success.

  • Serve as a tax SME for customer conversations involving compliance requirements, filing processes, and tax workflows.

  • Help customers understand how our platform supports their tax obligations and business needs.

  • Troubleshoot complex customer issues by collaborating with internal Tax, Product, Engineering, and Operations teams.

  • Translating customer feedback and pain points into product improvement opportunities.

  • Support customer escalations and help drive issues to resolution.

  • Create customer-facing documentation, enablement materials, and best practices.

  • Identifying patterns across customer needs and partnering with internal teams to improve processes and product capabilities.

  • Support strategic customer initiatives, including new country launches, regulatory changes, and new product offerings.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 4+ years of experience in tax operations, tax compliance, indirect tax, accounting operations, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of indirect tax compliance processes and operational workflows.

  • Experience working with customers, stakeholders, or cross-functional teams.

  • Ability to explain complex tax concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and customer needs in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfortable partnering with Product and Engineering teams to resolve issues and improve processes.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience working at a tax technology, SaaS, fintech, ERP, or financial software company.

  • Experience supporting enterprise customers or complex implementations.

  • Experience with tax automation platforms such as Avalara, Vertex, Sovos, or similar solutions.

  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or technical implementations.

  • Experience creating customer-facing documentation or enablement materials.

  • Experience working with Customer Success or Professional Services teams.

  • CPA, MST, CMI, or other relevant tax/accounting certification.

WHO YOU ARE

You'll thrive here if:

  • You're a Dog. You've been underestimated, gone through struggle, and never stopped running. You have a chip on your shoulder and enormous drive. You look at Stripe, Deel, and Flexport all punting on compliance and think: good, that means the opportunity is ours. Hunger beats pedigree.

  • Early stage is in your bones. You've built things where there's no playbook and nobody handing you the answer. You define the problem instead of waiting for instructions.

  • You own it end to end. Give you a goal and you figure out your own path. Small team, global surface area — everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. No one tells you how.

  • You believe speed and accuracy are both possible. We're building a complex product that requires robustness and 100% uptime, and we have to build at our customers' pace. Move fast. Don't break things. Both.

  • Being in the room is a feature, not a cost. Being in SF isn't a policy, it's how the work gets done. The speed and density of collaboration we need doesn't survive over video.

This won't be a fit if:

  • You need structure handed to you or ambiguity feels draining rather than motivating

  • You want to manage people more than own hard problems (we're a flat, experienced team — everyone builds)

  • You're used to "good enough" shipping (small errors have outsized impact here)

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The API Platform team is responsible for empowering teams to build highly reliable and performant services, backing our payment systems, fraud detection, and a multitude of other products. As an infrastructure team, you will build and expand the service frameworks to make complex systems easy to use, resilient, and scalable. We build powerful interfaces for engineers that depend on these systems—deployment, load balancers, web framework, databases, Kafka, and Kubernetes—while keeping them highly available and performant. We're looking for engineering leaders who drive the technical vision of Stripe's service infrastructure platform for thousands of engineers to use and build on top of, and thrive in a highly autonomous environment with many moving pieces.

You will join as a Technical Lead for one of the most impactful teams at Stripe. You will lead a team of engineers, collaborate with infrastructure and product engineering orgs, and advance service-oriented architecture (SOA) adoption at Stripe. By collaborating with the team's technical leaders, you will ensure the software your team builds meets the needs of Stripe and its customers.

We are a highly effective team that consistently delivers high-impact results while genuinely caring for one another. We expect you to bring your curiosity and critical thinking skills to this challenging domain.

We are looking for individuals with a strong background in designing and delivering high-performance infrastructure products for both internal and external customers. We would love to hear from you whether you have spent your entire career in infrastructure or are looking to apply your skill set to the database engineering domain for the first time.

Responsibilities

  • Lead a team of talented engineers, providing mentorship, guidance, and support to ensure their success
  • Partner with Engineering Managers to create roadmaps that deliver milestones toward a cohesive engineering vision
  • Understand user needs and pain points to prioritize engineering work and deliver high-quality solutions that meet user needs
  • Drive the execution of projects, overseeing the entire development lifecycle from planning to delivery, while maintaining high standards of quality and timely completion
  • Work with high-visibility teams and their stakeholders to support the Infrastructure's key engineering initiatives
  •  Provide hands-on technical leadership (architecture and design, vision, direction, and requirements setting, and incident response processes) for team members
  • Work with leaders across the company to create and drive toward the longer term vision of Stripe's services roadmap
  • Build a collaborative and inclusive work environment, promoting innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the team

Who you are

Minimum requirements

  • 12+ years of technical experience
  • 5+ years in a strategic technical leadership role
  • Experience leading engineering team(s) working on API design, abstractions, frameworks, or client libraries (e.g., building internal or external developer products)
  • Hands-on experience building infrastructure and products for internal or external customers
  • Proven track record of delivering pragmatic solutions that accelerate business growth
  • Ability to adjust conversations from high-level discussions to detailed coding
  • Thrives on a high level of autonomy and responsibility
  • Clear and persuasive writing and in-person communication
  • Strong problem-solving skills, critical thinking, determination, and a growth mindset
  • Ability to work effectively with a diverse group of people, genuinely caring for each other and contributing to a high level of psychological safety for all team members and partners
  • Proficient in at least one of the programming languages (Java, Ruby, Python, Go)

Preferred qualifications

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for different audiences (leadership, users, company-wide)
  • Experience with a variety of common infrastructure platforms (databases, logging, event streams, metrics, caching, etc.)
  • Experience leading partially remote and distributed teams
  • Experience developing sustainable, in-house framework and abstraction ecosystems in large engineering orgs
  • Experience building serverless platforms
  • Experience managing rigorous incident response processes and on-call rotations

We don't expect deep expertise in every dimension above, but genuine curiosity about any of the areas that are less familiar is important to us

    The north star for this role is revenue expansion within existing accounts.     Evan Doyle, Director of Demand Generation & Marketing Operations

Pace
Standards
Startup velocity — Decisions move fast. Priorities shift. You ship, iterate, and adapt — without waiting for perfect conditions or top-down direction.
Financial institution rigour — Audit trails matter. Regulators scrutinise. The bar for accuracy, documentation, and accountability is institutional-grade — always.

About the role

We turn raw on-chain activity into trustworthy intelligence — clustering addresses into real-world entities, attributing them to services and actors, and surfacing risk for compliance and investigations teams. We're looking for a data scientist who is as comfortable shipping a heuristic to production as they are designing it: someone who can move from a messy hypothesis to a working pipeline without waiting on someone else to wire up the data.

You'll work closely with our attribution and clustering leads on models and heuristics that run across billions of transactions and multiple chains (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tron, Solana, and more).

What you'll do

  • Design, test, and ship clustering and attribution heuristics, and measure them with real precision/coverage metrics rather than vibes.

  • Own your data end to end — pull, clean, join, and model large on-chain datasets without depending on a separate team for every query.

  • Build and maintain the pipelines that take a heuristic from notebook to production, including backfills, incremental runs, and validation.

  • Investigate edge cases (mixers, bridges, exchange hot wallets, consolidation patterns) and translate findings into repeatable logic.

  • Partner with investigations and product to define what "correct" looks like and benchmark against ground truth.

  • Prototype quickly, then harden what works.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years building data science or data engineering systems that actually shipped (not just notebooks).

  • Strong Python and SQL; comfortable with large datasets and the gotchas of joins, dedup, and skew at scale.

  • Solid grasp of clustering, graph/network analysis, or entity resolution — and a habit of validating results, not just producing them.

  • Ability to reason about precision vs. coverage trade-offs and defend your metrics.

  • Self-directed: you can scope an ambiguous problem, get the data yourself, and drive it to a result.

  • Own your data end to end — pull, clean, join, and model large on-chain datasets without depending on a separate team for every query.
